title: Conditions for Returning Unopened Ostomy Supply Program Items
content:
Larkfield accepts a return of Ostomy Supply Program items only of items that are unopened and in their original sealed packaging. Opened medical supplies are never returned to stock or credited on any tier where opened items are not returnable, because a supply that has left Larkfield's control cannot be re-dispensed to another patient. A box of barriers or pouches opened to check the size or cut is opened and is not returnable.

## Conditions for a return authorization

1. **Time.** A return is authorized only when the customer asks for it no later than the tier's return window in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that shipment, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed.
2. **Proof of delivery.** A shipment without a proof of delivery cannot be returned.
3. **Damage.** A package damaged in transit is handled as a replacement, not a return.
4. **Quantity.** The units authorized for return never exceed the units of that shipment, less any units of it already authorized for return.
5. **Condition.** The items are unopened and in their original sealed packaging.

## On receipt at the warehouse

- When the warehouse accepts the returned units as unopened and sealed, the units are credited back to the authorization they were drawn from.
- A payer-billed shipment is then re-billed by a void claim (all units returned) or a corrected claim (some units returned).
- A self-pay shipment is credited to the customer's balance at the price paid for the returned units less the tier's restocking fee percent.
- Returned units the warehouse finds opened are not accepted and no receipt is recorded.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Case | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Return window 30 days, delivery on day 0, request on day 30 | Authorized - the last day is allowed |
| Same shipment, request on day 31 | Not authorized |
| Shipment of 20 units, 5 already authorized for return, request for 18 | At most 15 units may be authorized |
| Self-pay return of units for which the customer paid USD 40.00, restocking fee 15% | Credit of USD 34.00 |
| Payer-billed shipment, all units returned and accepted | Void claim |
| Payer-billed shipment, some units returned and accepted | Corrected claim |
